_instructions: 1. Copy this file to 'config.json' in the same directory. 2. Customize the values below. 3. The config.json file is gitignored and will not be committed.
_updateTypesNote: Valid values: Security, Critical, Important, Recommended, Optional
_npmNote: npm global CLI tools are invisible to winget/choco - list their package names in NpmGlobalPackages (e.g. "@anthropic-ai/claude-code") to keep them updated; an empty list skips the stage. NpmCommand may be an absolute path to npm.cmd for SYSTEM scheduled tasks where a user-profile node is not on PATH. NpmPrefix targets a specific npm global prefix (the directory whose bin holds the tools) instead of the invoking account's default.
_wingetNote: Leave WingetCommand as "winget" unless you have a reason not to. winget reaches PATH through a per-user App Execution Alias, which a SYSTEM scheduled task does not have; the script falls back on its own to globbing C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_*_8wekyb3d8bbwe\winget.exe, so no configuration is needed for that case. Set an absolute path here only to override the search. Never point it at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\winget.exe - that is a zero-byte alias stub that resolves but does not execute outside its owning user session. A SYSTEM context sees machine-scope packages only; user-scope installs (per-user apps such as browsers, Discord, VS Code User setup) are invisible to it regardless of this setting - sweep those with a separate at-logon task running as the interactive user.
_autoRebootNote: If true, system will automatically reboot after updates if required
_logRetentionNote: Logs older than this many days will be automatically deleted
_skipRestorePointNote: If true, no system restore point will be created before updates
